text: {"final":{"tasks":[{"agent":"observability","goal":"Establish the timeline of stale stock prices: determine when quoted prices first stopped updating (roughly ten minutes before the reports) and whether the onset was abrupt or gradual. Compare the timestamp/age of the latest quote in market-data output, in redis-cache entries for quotes, and in what orchestrator and llm-gateway returned to users. Identify at which hop the data stops being fresh.","hints":["Focus on the window from about 30 minutes before the first user report to now, during market hours","Check market-data feed/tick rate, last-update timestamps, and quote cache hit/miss and TTL metrics in redis-cache","Check whether all symbols are stale or only a subset"],"depends_on_goal":[]},{"agent":"observability","goal":"Collect error, warning and anomaly signals around the onset from market-data, redis-cache, broker-gateway, portfolio-svc, portfolio-consumer, orchestrator and llm-gateway logs and metrics: connection drops, reconnects, timeouts, rate limits, cache write failures, serialization or schema errors. Also check queue depth, consumer lag, unacked messages and consumer counts on rabbitmq for portfolio-updates, inbound-msgs and outbound-msgs, and whether any service stopped emitting logs or metrics.","hints":["Compare the ten minutes before onset with the ten minutes after","Look for silence (missing logs/heartbeats) as well as errors","Note whether the LLM gateway or orchestrator is serving cached or repeated responses, e.g. response cache hit rate or tool-call results reused"],"depends_on_goal":[]},{"agent":"dependency","goal":"Find every change near the incident time, from about 2 hours before the first stale-price report to now, across all services listed: deploys and rollbacks, config and environment changes (cache TTLs, feed credentials, endpoints, timeouts), database migrations on postgres, feature flag toggles, infra or scaling events, and scheduled jobs or cron changes. Report the exact timestamp, service and author/source of each.","hints":["Do not limit to deploys; include config, secrets/credential rotations, flags and migrations","Pay attention to market-data, redis-cache, broker-gateway, portfolio-svc, portfolio-consumer, orchestrator, llm-gateway","Include changes by third parties or upstream vendors if recorded"],"depends_on_goal":[]},{"agent":"dependency","goal":"Map the dependencies and queue links for the services involved in producing a stock price answer: which services produce and consume portfolio-updates, inbound-msgs and outbound-msgs; how market-data, broker-gateway, order-router, portfolio-svc, portfolio-consumer, redis-cache, postgres, orchestrator and llm-gateway connect on the quote path (source feed to cache to API to LLM tool call to user reply). Identify which components are upstream vs downstream of the quote cache, and any shared dependencies.","hints":["Return a path-ordered list of hops so effects can be told from causes","Note where caching or TTLs exist along the path","Note which services share redis-cache or postgres"],"depends_on_goal":[]},{"agent":"dependency","goal":"Search past incidents and postmortems for similar symptoms: stale or frozen market data or quotes, cache entries not refreshing or TTLs not expiring, feed disconnects, stalled queue consumers, or LLM responses reusing old tool results. Summarize what was observed, the services involved and how each was resolved, noting these are hints and not conclusions for this incident.","hints":["Include the detection signals used then and how long they took to show","Note differences from the current incident"],"depends_on_goal":[]}]}}

{"final":{"summary":"The change query covering all services and all four kinds (deploy, config, migration, flag) for 08:30-11:30 UTC returned only three deploys, and none of them is on market-data or redis-cache. {"final":{"summary":"Four past-incident searches returned only two loosely related incidents. INC-0412 (2026-01-18) is the closest hint: a Redis restart evicted hot context and caused a cache stampede on portfolio-svc, and was fixed by restarting Redis and pre-warming hot keys. INC-0388 (2025-12-09) is an unrelated bank-side aggregator outage. No past incident matched stale quotes from a feed disconnect, a stalled portfolio-updates consumer, or an LLM reusing old tool results.
